title: Burst The Lanterns Best Score
description:
## Task

A row of paper lanterns hangs on a string, lantern `i` having brightness `glow[i]`. You pop them one at a time, in any order you choose. Popping lantern `i` scores `left * glow[i] * right`, where `left` and `right` are the brightness of the nearest lanterns still hanging on each side. If there is no lantern on a side, use 1 for it. Find the maximum total score from popping all of them.

## Input

- `glow` — a list of non-negative integers. It may be empty.

## Output

The maximum total score over all pop orders.

## Example

```python
lantern_score([3, 1, 5, 8])  # returns 167
lantern_score([4])  # returns 4
lantern_score([])  # returns 0
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `glow` ≤ 300
- 0 ≤ each brightness ≤ 100
- Trying every pop order is far too slow for the larger inputs; an interval-based method is expected.
